description: Most recent verified sales for one card (up to 10): date, grading company + grade, price in USD, marketplace name. Sales span US, Japan-domestic and Chinese marketplaces — each sale is a real completed transaction, not a listing. Reads POKEKA market data only; server-side request logging is disclosed in the privacy policy; does not modify user data.
name: recent_sales

finish.description: Print finish of the card sold (1st_edition, shadowless, reverse_holo, no_symbol, red_cheeks, yellow_cheeks, …; finish_name gives the display name). Combinations are joined with "+" (e.g. 1st_edition+red_cheeks). base = the regular (Unlimited) printing. unknown = the sale does not record whether it was 1st Edition or regular (only on cards that have both); it is not a price for either printing. Absent = no edition distinction recorded for that sale.

flag.description: Present only on sales our checks flagged: no support for that price on other platforms. Flagged sales are not counted in the POKEKA estimate.

reason.description: The facts behind the flag, in English.

title: Recent sales
